seoTitle: Currys Black Friday 2026: Dates, Deals & Price Promise
title: Currys Black Friday 2026: dates, best deals and what to expect
description: When Currys Black Friday 2026 deals start, how its price promise works, and the TV, laptop and kitchen prices worth waiting for.
intro:
**Currys's Black Friday 2026 sale has been running since 28 October and now covers more than 2,300 discounted products.** It comes with a price guarantee: if an eligible Black Friday item you buy by 24 November gets cheaper at Currys before 1 December, Currys refunds the difference, as long as you register the purchase by 27 November.

Strong prices this week include the Dyson V15 Detect Absolute at £479 (close to its six-month low) and Philips's PerfectCare 8000 steam generator iron at £299.99, the lowest it has been in six months. The Shark Stratos cordless vacuum was still £199 (was £419.99) on 9 November. If you want the Ninja DualZone XL air fryer, John Lewis has it for £159.99 today, and Currys's Price Promise will match that. Last checked: 10 November 2026.

deals.note: Dyson's flagship cordless with a laser that shows up fine dust. Which? puts its six-month average at £620 and its low at £468, so this is close to the best it gets. John Lewis and Dyson charge the same. See our [Dyson Black Friday guide](/guides/dyson-black-friday-deals-2026/).

deals.note: A powerful steam generator that needs no temperature setting, so it suits families with a lot of ironing. Which? data shows a six-month average of £486, and this matches the six-month low.

deals.note: At its six-month low, according to Which?. With only 4GB of memory and 128GB of storage it's for browsing, email and schoolwork only, so don't buy it for anything heavier.

deals.note: £130 off, but it sold for £449 last Black Friday and during October's Prime sale. Use the price guarantee if you buy now, or wait. Our [coffee machine guide](/guides/coffee-machine-black-friday-deals-2026/) has target prices.

body:
## When does Currys Black Friday 2026 start?

It already has. Currys launched its Black Friday sale on 28 October 2026, a day or two earlier than in 2025. It started with about 1,500 discounted products and had more than 2,300 by early November, with new offers added each week. The sale is expected to run until Tuesday 1 December, the day after Cyber Monday.

Past years:

- **2025:** started on 29 or 30 October and ran to Cyber Monday (1 December). Most deals ended at midnight that night.
- **2024:** the sale was already live by 1 November, with over 2,000 products reduced.

The main event runs from Black Friday (27 November) to Cyber Monday (30 November). For other retailers' dates, see our [when is Black Friday 2026 guide](/guides/when-is-black-friday-2026-uk/).

## Currys's Black Friday price guarantee

If you buy an eligible Black Friday item from Currys between 28 October and 24 November 2026, and Currys then sells it for less before 1 December, it will refund the difference. You must register your purchase at curryspriceguarantee.co.uk by 27 November, so do it as soon as you order. Refunds are expected from 11 December. It only covers Currys's own price, not other shops (for those, use the everyday price match below).

In 2025, Currys also said every Black Friday deal would be 'the lowest price it's ever been' at Currys, and it labelled items with an 'Our Lowest Ever Price' badge. That's a useful check, but it only refers to Currys's own prices, not other shops.

## Price matching

Currys's everyday Price Promise matches any other UK retailer's price, in store or online, including discount codes. You can claim before you buy or up to seven days after. It won't match marketplace sellers, membership or loyalty prices, or staff, student and NHS codes. So if Amazon or Argos is cheaper, ask Currys to match it.

## Currys Perks, trade-in and recycling

- **Apple Music:** new subscribers get two months free with selected tech bought by 21 November.
- **Currys Perks** is free to join with an email address. Members get exclusive prices and offers, and Currys is running a prize draw for a £500 gift card ahead of Black Friday.
- **Trade-in:** you can trade old tech for a gift card in store or a bank payment online, and put it towards something new.
- **Recycling:** Currys will recycle any old tech for free in its stores, even if you didn't buy it there.

## What was cheap at Currys last Black Friday

These 2025 Black Friday prices are a good guide to what to expect:

- Ninja Max 6-in-1 Dual Zone air fryer: £158 (was £229.99)
- De'Longhi Magnifica S bean-to-cup coffee machine: £299 (was £479.99)
- Dyson V15s Detect Submarine: £599 (was £799)
- Apple iPad 11in 128GB: £299 (was £329)
- Lenovo Yoga Slim 7 OLED laptop: £549 (was £849)
- Philips 5000 Series air fryer: £170

The best categories at Currys tend to be OLED TVs and soundbars, mid-range laptops and iPads, coffee machines, air fryers and cordless vacuums. For target prices by brand, see our guides to [TV Black Friday deals](/guides/tv-black-friday-deals-2026/), [air fryers](/guides/air-fryer-black-friday-deals-2026/) and [Dyson](/guides/dyson-black-friday-deals-2026/).

## How to get the best Currys deal

1. **Check the price history.** A big 'save £X' isn't always a real saving. Use a price tracker or compare with our target prices.
2. **Use the price promise.** If you see the same product cheaper at another big retailer, ask Currys to match it.
3. **Don't wait too long on popular TVs.** The best-value OLED sizes can sell out over Black Friday weekend.

### When do Currys Black Friday deals start in 2026?

They already have. The sale started on 28 October 2026 and is expected to run until 1 December. The biggest cuts usually come over Black Friday weekend, 27 to 30 November.

### Does Currys price match on Black Friday?

Its Price Promise matches other UK retailers' prices, including discount codes, before you buy or up to seven days after. Marketplace sellers and membership prices are excluded.

### What is the Currys Black Friday price promise?

If an eligible Black Friday item you buy by 24 November gets cheaper at Currys before 1 December, Currys refunds the difference. You must register the purchase by 27 November.

### Is it worth buying from Currys now or waiting?

Buying now carries little risk if you register for the price guarantee, because you'll get the difference back if the price falls. Some items, like the Dyson V15 and the Philips iron above, are already close to their lowest prices. Others, like the Sage Barista Express, were cheaper last Black Friday.

See every retailer and brand guide on our [Black Friday hub](/black-friday/).
